question.text: Company-specific (idiosyncratic) risk is mitigated PRIMARILY through:

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 42 defines company-specific risk as unsystematic/idiosyncratic risk and states it can be mitigated through diversification. The Trap: Leverage amplifies risk; fees and reducing returns do not lower firm-specific risk. Note: Source-backed by NISM-XXI-A page 42.
